name: Wells Fargo Reflect® Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. 17.74%, 24.24% or 28.49% variable APR thereafter. Balance transfers made within 120 days from account opening qualify for the introductory rate.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign Currency Conversion fee of 3% for each transaction amount converted to U.S. dollars.

rewards.currency_label: No rewards program (balance transfer / low APR card)

base_rate.description: No rewards earn rate advertised; card is focused on low intro APR / balance transfer.

rewards.redemption_notes: No rewards program advertised on product page.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 of cell phone protection against damage or theft. Subject to a $25 deductible.

benefits.title: Roadside Dispatch®
benefits.description: Available whenever you're in need of a tow – for eligible Wells Fargo cardholders 24/7 with no membership required.

benefits.title: My Wells Fargo Deals
benefits.description: Access to personalized deals from a variety of merchants. Activate deals, then shop, dine, or enjoy an experience using an eligible Wells Fargo credit card to earn cash back as an account credit.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.description: Built-in protection features ensure that you won't be held responsible for unauthorized transactions, as long as they're reported promptly.

benefits.title: Credit Close-Up®
benefits.description: Enroll to receive monthly FICO® Score updates and personalized credit insights. Complimentary to Wells Fargo Online® customers.

notes: Product page and Important Credit Terms checked 2026-10-18: 17.74%, 24.24% or 28.49% variable purchase APR after the 21-month 0% introductory period, no annual fee and 3% foreign currency conversion fee. Image URL is the Reflect card art referenced by the official product page; artwork remains Wells Fargo copyright. Visa's official card finder lists Reflect under Visa Traditional and identifies its benefitLevel as Traditional.
